column1: 6.2.2 Level - 2 Maintenance. This level of maintenance includes the repair of the
PCBs, replacement of components and subassemblies in the shop floor. These PCB /
Components / subassemblies are completely checked as per the procedures. For this
maintenance, test equipment and test jigs are required at naval dockyard.
6.2.3 Level - 3 Maintenance. OEM is involved in carrying out this level of
maintenance along with ship staff. This includes complete checking of the system
